title: UG-053 — How to use visibility settings and dependencies
intent: Provide detailed guidance for skip logic and dependent questions.
short_answer: Visibility settings let you show or hide elements depending on answers given to earlier single choice, multiple choice or matrix questions. This keeps the participant experience relevant and avoids unnecessary questions.
important_conditions: Visibility settings affect the Test page and published mode; all elements remain visible in the editor.
Elements with dependencies remain hidden to participants until at least one configured triggering answer is selected.
